title: Why LLM Agents Favor Their Group: Stakes, Observed Norms, and Reputation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring resource allocation (favoritism) in a point-sharing game between arbitrarily assigned in-group and out-group members under varying conditions of stakes, shared history, and visible group labels.

Evaluating point allocation and group mobility choices when agents are assigned differing amounts of public wealth (rich, mid, poor) to see if resource distribution is affected by economic inequality.
